standard_prerequisites.name: Gerbe criterion
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies properties (2)(a) and (2)(b) as the target conditions for X -> Y.

standard_prerequisites.name: Explicit 2-fibre product model
standard_prerequisites.use: Lets us assume X' = Y' x_Y X with explicit objects (U, y', x, alpha).

core_obligations: Fix the explicit fibre-product model for X'.
Property (2)(a): trivialize y locally through Y' -> Y, then trivialize the local y'_i through the gerbe condition on X' -> Y'; the composite covering works for X -> Y.

Property (2)(b): given x_1, x_2 over U and b : F(x_1) -> F(x_2), trivialize F(x_1)|_{U_i} through Y' -> Y; form the two fibre-product objects x'_{1i}, x'_{2i} over y'_i; the identity on y'_i is a morphism between their Y'-images, so (2)(b) for X' -> Y' gives local morphisms a'_{ij}; their projections to X are the desired lifts.
proof_roadmap: Work in the explicit fibre-product model; thread each gerbe property through the locally essentially surjective leg G and then through the gerbe X' -> Y'.
difficulty_reason: Both property lifts route through two stacked conditions with an explicit object construction in the fibre product doing the transfer; the (2)(b) step requires unwinding morphisms of the fibre product.
